name: Fairchild 22
summary: Early-1930s two-seat sport and training monoplane with a parasol wing, held above the fuselage on struts, and two tandem open cockpits.

wings: Parasol wing mounted above the fuselage on struts, with a gap between the wing and the fuselage
engines: Inverted inline four-cylinder or small radial in the nose
tail: Braced conventional tail unit with a rounded fin and rudder

tellTales: Parasol wing held above the fuselage by struts
Two tandem open cockpits under the wing
Braced tail unit and tailwheel gear

confusedWith.howToTell: The Junior has a different, shorter parasol wing and pylon; the Fairchild 22's wing is braced with struts above the cockpits.
The 24 is a cabin high-wing with enclosed seats; the 22 has a parasol wing and open cockpits.
The J-2 is a high-wing with a fuselage-mounted wing and V-struts; the Fairchild 22 has a parasol wing.
